name: Aero
doc: Aero (spell): one target task per action, in turn (one every 10 ticks), each a whirlwind layout at the target's feet and a gust at its effect position, scaled by its size, and a leaf a tick circling it, climbing, then falling and bouncing away; the target takes the result when both layouts have finished.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

leaf.doc: a prim model (its vertex frames and polygons; drawn by 0x572200)

magic_buffer.doc: Offsets in the magic buffer: the two packet arenas the director alternates, the layouts' blended vertex frames (after the target and leaf pools).

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The root starts one target task per action, in turn; each target task's clock: its sound; the result when both layouts have finished (draws nothing)

parts.title: Wind
parts.doc: The whirlwind at the target's feet and the gust at its effect position, scaled by its size

parts.title: Leaves
parts.doc: A leaf a tick circling the target and climbing, then falling and bouncing away

groups.label: Size
groups.doc: Both layouts scaled by ((the target's size >> 1) + Base) >> Shift (4096 = their own size); the leaves' reach too

groups.label: Spawning
groups.doc: One leaf spawned at every target tick From tick .. To tick

params.label: Every
params.doc: The root starts the next action's target task every this many ticks

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays at the target's effect position when the target tick == this

params.label: From tick
params.doc: Both layouts drawn from this target tick

params.label: Size
params.doc: A leaf's first size (4096 = its own); it grows to 4096

params.label: Climb
params.doc: Its first vertical speed (y goes down)

params.label: Climb until
params.doc: It climbs while its target task's tick is below this, then falls

params.label: Faster from
params.doc: It climbs and turns faster from this target tick

tasks.doc: One per action: its sound at the target's effect position; from tick 11 the whirlwind at the target's feet and the gust at its effect position (the anchor callback scaled by its size, record flags 0x1000: through the effect camera matrix, 0x8000, 0x100; its record scale applied row by row as 16-bit factors); a leaf a tick; the result when both layouts have finished.
A leaf model tumbling on three axes, circling its target task's anchor and climbing while that task is young, then falling, bouncing and drifting away, shrinking out.
